entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. Yes, um, I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and I'm just... I'm not really sure how this works. The website was a bit confusing for me.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?
Right, okay. It should be VF-8675309.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero helmet, delivered 28 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken. It's just... the color isn't quite what I expected from the pictures. It clashes with my bike. I feel silly, but the box is still unopened. I haven't even touched the helmet itself. I'm just so overwhelmed with the process. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. It's completely understandable to want your gear to match, and it's important you feel good about your safety equipment. Let me just confirm the return policy for you.
Okay, I've checked our system. Since the helmet was delivered 28 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was worried it would be a problem.

Not a problem at all. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and you can drop it off at any post office. As soon as we receive the helmet, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
That's perfect. Thank you again for making that so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
